proposals.title: Proposal No. 7 – Special Shareowner Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws so holders of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS YOU VOTE AGAINST THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL SEEKING ADOPTION OF AN ALTERNATIVE SHAREHOLDER RIGHT TO CALL A SPECIAL MEETING PROVISION.
